chunks: Mu‘āwiyah ibn ‘Ammār narrated from Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The two garments of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in which he entered ihram were two Yemeni cloths, one ‘Ibrī and one Ẓafār, and in these two he was shrouded.

key_terms.أَحْرَمَ: entered the state of ihram for pilgrimage
key_terms.ظَفَارِ: a type or designation of cloth associated with Ẓafār
key_terms.عِبْرِيٌّ: a type or designation of Yemeni cloth

ai.seo_question: What garments did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم wear for ihram and use for his shroud?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the specific garments worn by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم for ihram, identifying them as two Yemeni cloths. It also notes that he was shrouded in those same two garments, preserving a detail of his sunnah and personal practice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2594 - Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:

"The two garments in which the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) entered Ihram were Yemeni cloths, one 'Abriyy and the other Zafariyy, and in these two garments, he was shrouded."
